_comment: Read-only pre- and post-state checks for the five Step 3B migrations. Each value is ONE SELECT statement returning one boolean. pre_work_remaining is true while the file still has work to do (false means its effect is already present and the file is a verified no-op); post_effect_present is true once the file has run. A rule is evidence that the CURRENT state is consistent with the migration, never proof that the migration ran. Validated by src/lib/tests/security/step3bMigrationPlan.test.ts on the repository chain, the Production-shaped and the Development-shaped scratch databases.

20261026120000.effect: sequence privileges; anon table privileges follow policies; one pinned search_path
20261026120000.pre_work_remaining: SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT oid FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relkind = 'S' OFFSET 0) c WHERE has_sequence_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'USAGE') OR has_sequence_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'UPDATE') OR has_sequence_privilege('authenticated', c.oid, 'UPDATE')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND has_table_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies p WHERE p.schemaname = 'public' AND p.tablename = c.relname AND p.roles && ARRAY['anon','public']::name[]))) AS work_remaining
20261026120000.post_effect_present: SELECT (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT oid FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relkind = 'S' OFFSET 0) c WHERE has_sequence_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'USAGE') OR has_sequence_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'UPDATE') OR has_sequence_privilege('authenticated', c.oid, 'UPDATE')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND has_table_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies p WHERE p.schemaname = 'public' AND p.tablename = c.relname AND p.roles && ARRAY['anon','public']::name[]))) AS effect_present
20261026120000.also_verify: unpinned SECURITY DEFINER count is 0: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND p.prosecdef AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(coalesce(p.proconfig, '{}')) c WHERE c LIKE 'search_path=%')

20261026120100.effect: service_role SELECT on the eight Event Essentials catalog tables
20261026120100.pre_work_remaining: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['inventory_products','product_pricing','product_categories','product_bundles','product_bundle_components','package_inflatable_components','package_inflatable_eligibility','product_bundle_excluded_categories']) t WHERE to_regclass('public.' || t) IS NOT NULL AND NOT has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.' || t, 'SELECT')) AS work_remaining
20261026120100.post_effect_present: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['inventory_products','product_pricing','product_categories','product_bundles','product_bundle_components','package_inflatable_components','package_inflatable_eligibility','product_bundle_excluded_categories']) t WHERE to_regclass('public.' || t) IS NOT NULL AND NOT has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.' || t, 'SELECT')) AS effect_present

20261026120200.effect: Crew task_status INSERT policy; Admin transaction_receipts UPDATE policy
20261026120200.pre_work_remaining: SELECT (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'task_status' AND policyname = 'Crew create task status') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'transaction_receipts' AND policyname = 'Admin and master update transaction receipts')) AS work_remaining
20261026120200.post_effect_present: SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'task_status' AND policyname = 'Crew create task status' AND cmd = 'INSERT') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'transaction_receipts' AND policyname = 'Admin and master update transaction receipts' AND cmd = 'UPDATE')) AS effect_present

20261026120300.effect: trigger rejecting browser-role writes to the booking-confirmation columns of orders
20261026120300.pre_work_remaining: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = 'public.orders'::regclass AND tgname = 'trg_guard_booking_confirmation_columns' AND NOT tgisinternal) AS work_remaining
20261026120300.post_effect_present: SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = 'public.orders'::regclass AND tgname = 'trg_guard_booking_confirmation_columns' AND NOT tgisinternal AND tgenabled = 'O') AND NOT has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.guard_booking_confirmation_columns()', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.guard_booking_confirmation_columns()', 'EXECUTE')) AS effect_present

20261026120400.effect: supabase_admin and postgres default privileges in public no longer name anon, authenticated or PUBLIC; the migration FAILS (no history row) if it cannot achieve that
20261026120400.pre_work_remaining: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_default_acl d CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(d.defaclacl) a WHERE d.defaclnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) IN ('supabase_admin', 'postgres') AND (a.grantee = 0 OR pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) IN ('anon', 'authenticated'))) AS work_remaining
20261026120400.post_effect_present: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_default_acl d CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(d.defaclacl) a WHERE d.defaclnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) IN ('supabase_admin', 'postgres') AND (a.grantee = 0 OR pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) IN ('anon', 'authenticated'))) AS effect_present
20261026120400.hosted_note: STEP 4 GATE: hosted capability of the migration operator to alter supabase_admin default privileges is unverified. Run pre_work_remaining read-only on the target project first. If it is true and the operator is refused, the migration FAILS (fail closed) and the owner closes the defaults once from the dashboard SQL editor as supabase_admin, then the migration passes as a no-op. Never record the version without post_effect_present being true.
